component.name: Halcyon
component.summary: Desktop widgets and themes for COSMIC

description.p: Halcyon puts a small set of widgets on your COSMIC desktop and gives the whole desktop a coordinated look: wallpaper, colors, windows, dock and panel.
Choose a starter look in a short first-run setup, then make it your own.

ul.li: Desktop setups with wallpaper, colors, widget layout and optional Islands compositions.
Clock, date, weather, system monitor, calendar, projects, music, notes and focus timer widgets with adjustable placement and sizing.
Thirteen widget styles, from soft cards and frosted glass to outlines, paper and terminal, with a matching dock and panel.
Review included parts before applying a setup, and undo eligible changes without overwriting unrelated edits.
Fresh packages enable signed system updates; existing disabled or modified update sources are preserved.

description.p: No account is needed. Share usage data is on by default and can be turned off in setup or App settings. While enabled, Halcyon attempts to send Google a daily activity report with a random installation ID, app version and approximate first country. Country.is supplies the country from the public IP; Halcyon does not store the IP or send widget content. Turning reporting off stops activity and country requests and sends a minimal preference-status update. Failed status delivery can retry for up to seven days; identifiable opted-out records are retained for at most 90 days.
Connecting Google Calendar is optional. Weather uses Open-Meteo and sign-in tokens stay in your system keyring.

ul.li: Apply only the parts of a look you want, or make your own in the Look studio.
New Rainy Lake and Deep Purple themes, icon packs, app icon shapes and accent folders.
Move, restyle or turn off the edge menu and choose what it lists.
Settings opens on a picture of your desktop, and Arrange matches the desktop exactly.
Rain on fogged glass with the clock behind it, resting while the desktop is hidden.
Activity island notification groups, live progress, a quick timer, a file shelf and styles.
Device batteries in the island and a new Devices widget.
Fewer panel restarts, less idle work, and settings that survive a bad value.
Wallpaper rain, snow, fog and cloud shadows can match the weather.
Place and resize the clock on a small copy of your screen.
Let the scene cover the clock on your own wallpapers, with scene lighting.
Islands setup shows one clear next step and plain reasons.
Changes lists your history by day, with Undo for each change.
Tidier Settings with explanations on request, better search and full keyboard support.
Much lower idle CPU and video memory use, and fixes on the Windows page.
Send usage reports directly to the new Halcyon collector.
Include which main features are switched on in the daily usage report.
Publish aggregate usage statistics.
Add the Activity island (beta) for music, meetings, notifications and camera or microphone use.
Add Rainy evening, First snow and Morning fog setups with new wallpapers.
Rearrange built-in setups and allow much more see-through widgets.
Rearrange Settings by what you change, with release notes in Updates.

description.p: Add native Fedora 44 packages and signed updates. Support COSMIC 1.11 on Fedora 43 and 44.

ul.li: Add GPU wallpaper rain, snow, fog and cloud shadows.
Customize Music and Focus widgets and circular audio visualizers.
Place and resize an audio spectrum, including behind the dock.
Add a Fedora RPM package with signed system updates.
Include Islands and optional Penumbra gradients in one package.
Schedule appearances using local solar times and adaptive looks.
Build Calendar and system-reading widgets.
Improve onboarding, setup review, layout editing and change history.

description.p: Fixes for display recovery, calendar refreshes, Notes saving, Islands activation and Settings navigation.

ul.li: Remix wallpapers, styles and layouts; import and share setup packages.
Customize clock faces and widget recipes, edit layouts in Canvas, and switch day/night Moments.
Settings uses responsive columns, compact controls and contextual help.
Install optional Islands through the system installer from Settings.
Fix setup wizard navigation and Islands source provenance checks.
Redesigned native Settings and six desktop Setups with optional Islands layouts.
Choose and order widgets during setup, with placement for each display.
Connect calendars and read-only iCal feeds, with calendar selection and Busy privacy mode.
Enable signed system updates for new installations while preserving existing choices.
Add local diagnostics and recent changes, with safer layout and interrupted-change recovery.
Add four shared glass materials, surface overrides and saved Liquid widget motion.
Extend materials to Dock and Panel with the updated active optional companion.
Qualify reviewed COSMIC sources with startup probes and stock fallback.
Fix Projects reading the current Halcyon configuration.
Add automatic daily activity and approximate country reporting with privacy disclosure; no widget content is sent.
Keep music progress and elapsed time visible after seeking in browser players.
Prevent normal logout or reboot from disabling Islands in the matching add-on.

description.p: First release with desktop widgets, six starter looks, thirteen widget styles and coordinated COSMIC themes.
